items.prompt: What evidence would you want before trusting an online variance implementation for a new numeric scale?
items.modelAnswer: Use hand-checked and independent-reference cases, empty/singleton handling, large offsets with small spreads, range/non-finite tests and explicit tolerances. State order/precision assumptions and remaining limits.

criteria.text: Uses an independent oracle and meaningful cases.
Checks numerical scale and special inputs.
